event_counter_model.scope: p3d33: local cuts are derived only from official Float32 checker events

family_iis_scope: p3d33 continuous V3 LP; group-level only, not row IIS
official_sink_policy: V1: no successor-choice or reachability constraints; only official G5/R5_loch/G6 event cuts and checker budgets

drainage_candidates.road_direction_policy: within 4.8 m of V3 route or WEGA road raster: flow is along the local ramp axis or moves away from it, with no lateral side crossing

p3d31_construction.drainage_formulation: official checker event cuts only; no per-cell successor or outlet reachability constraint
p3d31_construction.hard_curvature_tolerance_rule: max(0.02 m, 0.25 * abs(p3d17 reference second difference))
p3d31_construction.official_sink_policy: V1: no successor-choice or reachability constraints; only official G5/R5_loch/G6 event cuts and checker budgets
p3d31_construction.outlet_note: All active work-area boundary cells are outlets. Each active non-outlet selects exactly one local successor; single-commodity unit supply at every non-outlet forces all selected paths to outlets and excludes directed cycles. The p3d29 Priority-Flood tree remains in the construction record for comparison but does not constrain the p3d31 active area.

p3d33_smoothness.rule: L1 deviation of second differences from p3d17 in active non-cliff gentle-slope stencils

p3d33_platform.outlet_direction_basis: negative bilinear central-difference gradient of p3d31 V3 round03 at 152.5|28.5

p3d33_ramp2_transition.C1: exact equal one-sided first differences at both fixed/variable seams
